description.zh: 专为 AI Agent / AI 助手类产品写信息流广告口播，用于抖音、视频号、快手、小红书、B 站付费投放获客：把技术能力翻译成人群听得懂的卖点，写前 3 秒抓人、录屏演示清楚、行动引导明确的 15/30/60 秒口播，一次给出多个测试版本；自动检查时长、钩子、引导和广告合规风险（极限词、收益承诺、取代人工、冒用大模型品牌等）；生成测试矩阵和素材命名，导入投放数据给出放量、关停和改稿建议。
description.en: Writes paid-feed ad voiceovers for AI agent / assistant products on Douyin, WeChat Channels, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu and Bilibili: turns capabilities into audience-level selling points, writes 15/30/60-second scripts with a strong 3-second hook, clear demos and calls to action in several test variants, checks duration and ad-compliance risks, builds test matrices and naming, and reviews campaign data to scale, stop or rewrite creatives.

welcome_message.zh: 说说你的 AI 产品能帮用户做什么，打算投哪个平台
welcome_message.en: Tell me what your AI product does and where you plan to advertise

prompt.zh: 帮我的 AI 产品 ___ 写 3 版 30 秒投流口播，投 ___ 平台，目标是让用户 ___（注册/留资/下载）。
prompt.en: Write three 30-second ad voiceovers for my AI product ___ on ___, goal: ___ (sign-up/lead/download).

prompt.zh: 我的产品能做这些：___，帮我提炼给 ___（人群）看的卖点。
prompt.en: My product can do: ___. Turn it into selling points for ___ (audience).

prompt.zh: 给这条口播写 10 个不同类型的开头钩子：___
prompt.en: Write 10 hooks of different types for this script: ___

prompt.zh: 帮我检查这版口播有没有容易被拒审的说法，并改写：___
prompt.en: Check this voiceover for risky claims and rewrite: ___

prompt.zh: 帮我规划下周的素材测试：钩子 ___，卖点 ___，引导 ___，最多 ___ 条。
prompt.en: Plan next week's tests: hooks ___, points ___, CTAs ___, at most ___ creatives.

prompt.zh: 这是投放后台导出的数据 ___，帮我复盘哪些素材该放量、关停或改稿。
prompt.en: Here is the campaign export ___; tell me which creatives to scale, stop or rewrite.

zh: 每周一「10:00」根据上周投放数据复盘素材，给出放量、关停和改稿建议
每周三「10:00」写 3 个新的口播版本补充素材库
每天「18:00」检查当天新写的口播稿合规风险
每月 1 日「10:00」汇总上月表现最好的钩子和卖点
每周五「17:00」规划下周的素材测试矩阵
产品上新功能后「立即」写一组新功能的投流口播
en: Every Monday at 10:00, review last week's ad data and recommend scale/stop/rewrite
Every Wednesday at 10:00, write three new voiceover variants
Every day at 18:00, compliance-check scripts written that day
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, summarise last month's best hooks and selling points
Every Friday at 17:00, plan next week's creative test matrix
After each product feature launch, write a set of ad scripts for it
